about: Renders a number field with a button on either side that steps the value down or up. The arrow keys step the value from the field. The value is formatted for `locale` and clamped to `min` and `max` on blur.
capped: Up to 50% off the list price.

controlled.about: The caller holds the value in state, passes it as `value` and takes each change from `onValueChange`. The helper text shows the total at 12 euros a licence, and asks for a number while the field is empty.
controlled.title: Controlled

field.about: Inside a field the input takes its name from the field's label and its description from the helper text. `formatOptions` formats the value as euros in `en-GB`, and `step` moves it by 50.
field.title: In a field

looks.about: The input group's three looks. The buttons are 4px from the box's ends and use the field's muted ink on each look.
looks.title: Looks

noTotal: Enter a number of licences to see the total.
paid: Paid out on the next business day.

percent.about: `style: "percent"` formats the value as a percentage. The value is the text the field shows, `15%`, and `valueAsNumber` is 0.15. `step` moves it by five points, and `max` stops it at 50%.
percent.title: Percentage

scrubber.about: Drag the arrows sideways to change the value. The arrow keys in the field do the same, so the scrubber needs no keyboard of its own.
scrubber.title: Scrubber

size.about: Every size of the box. The buttons read the tag scale at the same size and are never under 24px.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: A value over the maximum of 50 is invalid until the field clamps it on blur. A read-only input and a disabled one disable both buttons.
states.title: States

title: Number input
